billing.subtitle: Your plan, monthly invoices, the 15% commission on delivered sales, payments and payouts.

overview.graceDays: Invoices are due {{n}} days after the billing date.
overview.estimateHint: Billed on {{date}}. Final amounts are calculated on that day.

plans.usageHint: Compared with the limits of your current plan.
plans.ownerOnly: Only the store owner can change the plan
plans.ownerOnlyBody: You can compare plans and see usage here. Ask the store owner to upgrade or downgrade.
plans.pendingUpgradeTitle: Upgrade to {{plan}} is waiting for payment
plans.pendingUpgradeBody: Invoice {{number}} for {{amount}} is due on {{date}}. The new plan starts as soon as it is paid.

scheduled.cancel: Your subscription ends on {{date}} and the store moves to {{plan}}

plans.scheduledBody: Until then you keep every feature of your current plan. Nothing is deleted when the plan changes.
plans.upInvoice: We create an invoice for {{price}} per month, due in {{days}} days.
plans.upCredit: If you already paid for the current month, the unused days are credited on that invoice.
plans.upActivates: The new plan starts the moment the invoice is paid. If it is not paid in time it simply expires and you stay on your current plan.
plans.downWhen: The change happens at the end of the current period, on {{date}}. You keep your current features until then.
plans.downNothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted. Products, sections and team members over the new limits stay, but adding new ones is blocked.
plans.overProducts: You have {{used}} products; the new plan allows {{max}}.
plans.overStaff: You have {{used}} team members; the new plan allows {{max}}.
plans.overSections: Your store page has {{used}} sections; the new plan allows {{max}}.
plans.duesCarried: Any outstanding invoices and unpaid commission stay due whatever plan you choose.
plans.invoiceCreated: Invoice {{number}} created. Pay it to start the new plan.
plans.footnote: Every plan pays the same {{pct}}% commission on delivered marketplace sales (shipping excluded). In-shop POS sales have no commission.

invoices.emptyBody: Monthly invoices appear here at the end of each billing period.

pay.title: Pay {{amount}}
pay.subtitle: Choose how you want to pay this invoice.
pay.notEnough: Your available balance is {{short}} short of the amount due. Use a bank or wallet transfer instead.
pay.confirmBalanceBody: The amount is taken from your available Souqly balance and invoice {{number}} is marked paid.
pay.transferTo: Send {{amount}} to one of these Souqly accounts. Write {{number}} in the transfer note, then submit the transaction reference below.
pay.referenceHint: The TID / reference number from your bank or wallet receipt.
pay.proofHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB.
pay.submittedToast: Submitted. Souqly will verify your payment soon.
pay.noAccountsTitle: Transfer details are not available yet
pay.noAccountsBody: Souqly has not added a bank or wallet account for transfers. Please pay from your balance or contact support.
pay.awaitingBody: You submitted a transfer on {{date}}. Souqly will verify it shortly; the invoice is marked paid once approved.
pay.gatewayPendingBody: Finish the checkout to complete the payment. The invoice updates automatically once the payment is confirmed.
pay.onlineHint: Online payment methods appear here as soon as Souqly enables them.
pay.ownerOnly: Only the store owner can pay invoices
pay.ownerOnlyBody: Ask the store owner to pay this invoice.

commissions.basis: 15% of the product amount after your own discounts. Shipping is not included. Charged only when an order is delivered.
commissions.emptyBody: Commission is recorded when an order is delivered.

payouts.holdDays: Online sales are held {{n}} days after delivery
payouts.requestHint: Withdraw your available balance to your payout account. Minimum {{amount}}.
payouts.belowMinimum: You need at least {{amount}} available to request a payout. Available now: {{available}}.
payouts.noMethodBody: Payouts are sent to the bank or wallet account in your store settings.
payouts.emptyBody: Your payout requests and their status appear here.

suspended.title: Your store is suspended for billing
suspended.overdueBody: Your store is hidden from buyers because {{amount}} is overdue. You can still manage orders. Pay your dues to go live again automatically.
suspended.adminBody: Souqly put your store on a billing hold. Reason: {{note}}. Contact support if you have questions.

publishPaused.title: Publishing is paused
publishPaused.body: While your store is suspended for billing, products cannot be published. You can still edit and save drafts.
publishPaused.short: Publishing is paused until billing dues are paid.

gate.body: Your {{plan}} plan does not include this. It is available from the {{required}} plan.
gate.bodyAskOwner: Your {{plan}} plan does not include this. It is available from the {{required}} plan; ask the store owner to upgrade.

onboarding.commission: Every plan pays {{pct}}% commission on delivered sales. Nothing is charged for cancelled orders.
onboarding.paidNote: Your store starts on Free. After you submit, an invoice for the chosen plan appears in Seller Center > Billing; the plan starts when it is paid.
onboarding.changeLater: You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel any time from Seller Center.
onboarding.monthly: Plans are billed monthly. COD commission is billed on the monthly invoice; for online payments it is deducted before your balance is credited.

overview.subtitle: Subscriptions, the flat {{pct}}% commission, invoices and payouts across all sellers.
overview.sweepBody: Runs the daily billing job now: records missing commissions, issues due renewal invoices, marks overdue invoices and suspends late stores. It is safe to run more than once.

stores.subtitle: Every store's plan, billing status and outstanding dues.

actions.title: Billing actions
actions.planBody: Changes the plan immediately without an invoice. Any open upgrade invoice is voided.
actions.extendBody: Adds days to the current billing period. A scheduled change moves with it.
actions.suspendBody: Hides the store from buyers until an admin reactivates it. The seller can still log in, fulfil orders and pay.
actions.reactivateBody: Lifts the billing suspension and puts the store back on sale.

waive.title: Waive invoice {{number}}
waive.body: Amount due: {{amount}}. A waiver is recorded with your reason and cannot be undone.
waive.amountHint: Leave empty to waive the full {{amount}}.
waive.invalid: Enter an amount up to {{max}} and a reason of at least 5 characters.

payments.subtitle: Verify bank and wallet transfers submitted by sellers.

review.partialHint: Lower it if you received less; the rest stays due on the invoice.

invoices.subtitle: Monthly renewal and upgrade invoices of all sellers.
invoices.pendingPayment: A payment for this invoice is pending

adjustments.subtitle: Commission reversals from refunds and every waiver, extension, plan change and suspension.

reports.subtitle: Per-store subscription fees and commission for the selected dates.

settings.subtitle: Grace period and the accounts sellers transfer dues to.
settings.viewOnly: You can view these settings. Only Finance can change them.
settings.graceHint: Days after the billing date before an invoice is overdue and the store is suspended (0 to 60).
settings.accountsHint: Shown to sellers when they pay by bank or wallet transfer (up to 5).
settings.noAccounts: No transfer accounts yet. Sellers cannot pay by transfer until you add one.
settings.title: Label

commission.subtitle: One commission rate for every plan and category.
commission.fixedBody: {{pct}}% of the product amount after seller discounts, charged when an order is delivered. Shipping is excluded.
commission.legacyBody: These rules are kept for history only and are no longer applied. They cannot be edited.
commission.storeHint: Fixed platform rate for all stores. Per-store overrides are retired.

subtitles.plan: Start free or pick a paid plan for more products and tools. You can change it later.

errors.BILLING_SUSPENDED: Your store is suspended for billing. Pay your dues to continue.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Your available balance is not enough for this.
errors.PAYMENT_PENDING: A payment for this invoice is already waiting for verification.
errors.DUPLICATE_REFERENCE: This transaction reference has already been used.
errors.PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIGURED: This payment method is not available yet.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_PAYABLE: This invoice cannot be paid any more.
errors.INVOICE_CHANGED: The invoice changed. Please refresh and try again.
errors.ALREADY_ON_PLAN: Your store is already on this plan.
errors.COMMISSION_FIXED: Commission is fixed for every store and cannot be changed.
errors.ALREADY_SUSPENDED: This store is already suspended for billing.
errors.NOT_SUSPENDED: This store is not suspended for billing.
errors.NO_PAYOUT_METHOD: Add your payout account in store settings first.
errors.BELOW_MINIMUM: This amount is below the minimum.
